sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
instruct: Gender: neuter monster. Age: ancient. Role: three-headed hydra, a colossal serpentine beast guarding its lair. Pitch: very deep, subterranean, guttural. Pace: slow and menacing, with drawn-out syllables. Emotion: primal menace, cold predatory hunger, seething aggression. Characteristics: heavy rumbling growl, gravelly and reverberant, layered as if several throats speak at once, wet snarling texture. Use case: fantasy RPG boss-monster dialogue and threats issued from a swamp cavern.
